compose:
services:
  thewimo-Qwen3-4B-AWQ-8001:
    command:
    - thewimo/Qwen3-4B-AWQ
    - --max-model-len
    - '2048'
    - --max-num-seqs
    - '128'
    - --port
    - '8001'
    - --gpu-memory-utilization
    - '0.90'
    - --dtype
    - float16
    container_name: mcgyvr-srv2-thewimo-Qwen3-4B-AWQ-8001
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          devices:
          - capabilities:
            - gpu
            device_ids:
            - '0'
            driver: nvidia
    environment:
      HF_HUB_OFFLINE: '1'
    image: vllm/vllm-openai@sha256:ffb2d59b1c059a5bd8d781320c9f5189de8293693b7d95da54befddaa54abf52
    ipc: host
    network_mode: host
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
    - /home/adaramir/.cache/huggingface:/root/.cache/huggingface:ro
